subject.title: fix(ios): render Markdown lists and thematic breaks

question: Should the iOS renderer take this broader nested-list implementation, or first land the narrower conservative implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111208 and track nested-list support separately?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same reported behavior, but this branch intentionally expands into nested structural rendering while the sibling PR limits itself to simpler containers; selecting the permanent maintenance boundary requires iOS-owner judgment.

options.title: Land the narrower implementation first
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111208 for the reported top-level list and separator defect, then evaluate nested-list support as a focused follow-up.

options.title: Adopt this broader renderer
options.body: Retain this PR only after current-head simulator proof, native-i18n repair, and iOS-owner confirmation that nested-list rendering is the desired long-term scope.

recommendation.title: Land the narrower implementation first
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111208 for the reported top-level list and separator defect, then evaluate nested-list support as a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review directly covers the two semantic invariants that differentiate this broader implementation from the sibling PR.
